sliceagent.review:
- `taskq/queue.py`: Mutable default argument `items=[]` is shared across all `TaskQueue` instances.
- `taskq/queue.py`: `is_full()` uses `>` instead of `>=`, allowing one item beyond `capacity`.
- `taskq/worker.py`: Log file is opened but never closed in `run_once`, leaking the file descriptor on exceptions.
- `taskq/worker.py`: `run_once` swallows all handler exceptions and returns `None`, hiding failures.
- `taskq/scheduler.py`: `run_with_retry` never increments `attempts`, causing an infinite loop when `run_once` returns `None`.
- `taskq/store.py`: `find_by_name` builds SQL with string formatting, making it vulnerable to SQL injection.
